entries.markdown: [#133](https://github.com/meocord/meocord/pull/133) [`9153786`](https://github.com/meocord/meocord/commit/9153786e695a7d98c5d6b777e77cc07381e2c22e) Thanks [@l7aromeo](https://github.com/l7aromeo)! - Ships every change listed under 4.1.0-beta.2, which was not published on its own. Providers in `@MeoCord({ providers })` and in the testing module's `providers` can be listed in any order: a class listed there is bound once, even when a provider earlier in the list injects it.
